values.meaning: heal as percent of dead enemy's maximum health
values.binNote: Wiki's per-level values are the linear formula 1.8+(5.5-1.8)/17*(x-1) rounded to 4 significant digits; the bin's raw floats (e.g. 0.02017647 vs wiki's 0.0202) are the same underlying linear progression from 0.018 to 0.055 but carry more decimal precision. Reporting the wiki's rounded numbers as stated in its leveling text.

mechanics.claim: The heal triggers when a nearby enemy dies, not when Trundle deals the killing blow.
mechanics.quote: Whenever a nearby enemy dies, '''Trundle''' {{tip|heal|heals}} himself

mechanics.claim: The passive does not trigger from enemy structures being destroyed.
mechanics.quote: ''King's Tribute'' does not trigger when an enemy structure is destroyed.
